-- The three case-study companies (rule: analysis/pipeline.py CASE_RULE). Empty until the first run.


    select
        cast(case_rank as integer) as case_rank,
        cast(company_id as varchar) as company_id,
        cast(cik as bigint) as cik,
        cast(company_name as varchar) as company_name,
        cast(sector_de as varchar) as sector_de,
        cast(event_date as date) as event_date,
        cast(revenue_ttm_eur as double) as revenue_ttm_eur,
        cast(lead_months_ccc as double) as lead_months_ccc,
        cast(lead_months_z as double) as lead_months_z,
        cast(run_id as varchar) as run_id,
        cast(data_version as varchar) as data_version
    from read_parquet('/home/runner/work/bilanzwerk/bilanzwerk/data/analysis/case_studies.parquet')

-- H1-H4 as the model run decided them (analysis/answer.py). Empty until the first run.


    select
        cast(hypothesis_code as varchar) as hypothesis_code,
        cast(hypothesis as varchar) as hypothesis,
        cast(status as varchar) as status,
        cast(is_held as integer) as is_held,
        cast(estimate as double) as estimate,
        cast(ci_low as double) as ci_low,
        cast(ci_high as double) as ci_high,
        cast(unit as varchar) as unit,
        cast(text_de as varchar) as text_de,
        cast(text_en as varchar) as text_en,
        cast(run_id as varchar) as run_id,
        cast(data_version as varchar) as data_version
    from read_parquet('/home/runner/work/bilanzwerk/bilanzwerk/data/analysis/hypothesis_results.parquet')

-- Lead time of the CCC and Z'' flags per company with a bankruptcy (analysis/leadtime.py).
-- Empty until the first run.


    select
        cast(company_id as varchar) as company_id,
        cast(event_date as date) as event_date,
        cast(n_observations as integer) as n_observations,
        cast(lead_months_ccc as double) as lead_months_ccc,
        cast(lead_months_z as double) as lead_months_z,
        cast(ever_red_ccc as integer) as ever_red_ccc,
        cast(ever_red_z as integer) as ever_red_z,
        cast(ccc_available_last as integer) as ccc_available_last,
        cast(z_available_last as integer) as z_available_last,
        cast(run_id as varchar) as run_id,
        cast(data_version as varchar) as data_version
    from read_parquet('/home/runner/work/bilanzwerk/bilanzwerk/data/analysis/lead_times.parquet')

-- Pooled out-of-time backtest per model (analysis/backtest.py). Empty until the first run.


    select
        cast(model_name as varchar) as model_name,
        cast(n as bigint) as n,
        cast(n_pos as bigint) as n_pos,
        cast(pr_auc as double) as pr_auc,
        cast(recall_top5 as double) as recall_top5,
        cast(brier as double) as brier,
        cast(run_id as varchar) as run_id,
        cast(data_version as varchar) as data_version
    from read_parquet('/home/runner/work/bilanzwerk/bilanzwerk/data/analysis/model_backtest.parquet')

-- Risk scores written back by the early-warning model (analysis/). Empty until first run.

    select
        cast(cik as bigint) as cik,
        cast(as_of_date as date) as as_of_date,
        cast(model_name as varchar) as model_name,
        cast(probability_12m as double) as probability_12m,
        cast(risk_band as varchar) as risk_band,
        cast(top_3_drivers as varchar) as top_3_drivers,
        cast(run_id as varchar) as run_id
    from read_parquet('/home/runner/work/bilanzwerk/bilanzwerk/data/analysis/risk_scores.parquet')

-- The three case studies of report page 8, chosen by a fixed rule (analysis/pipeline.py), with
-- the company version that was valid at the event.
select
    s.case_rank,
    coalesce(c.company_key, cur.company_key) as company_key,
    s.company_id,
    s.cik,
    s.company_name,
    s.sector_de,
    s.event_date,
    s.revenue_ttm_eur,
    s.lead_months_ccc,
    s.lead_months_z,
    s.run_id
from "bilanzwerk"."staging"."stg_analysis__case_studies" as s
left join "bilanzwerk"."marts"."dim_company" as c
    on
        s.company_id = c.company_id
        and s.event_date >= c.valid_from
        and s.event_date < c.valid_to
-- an event before the first known company version falls back to the current one
left join "bilanzwerk"."marts"."dim_company" as cur
    on
        s.company_id = cur.company_id
        and cur.is_current = 1

-- The answer (H1-H4) as the last model run decided it, for the report's answer cards and the
-- titles that state a finding. Nothing on a report page is typed by hand.
select
    hypothesis_code,
    hypothesis,
    status,
    is_held,
    estimate,
    ci_low,
    ci_high,
    unit,
    text_de,
    text_en,
    run_id,
    data_version
from "bilanzwerk"."staging"."stg_analysis__hypothesis_results"

-- H1: one row per company with a bankruptcy, with the lead time of the CCC and Z'' flags in
-- months (null = the flag never turned red and stayed red) and whether each flag could be
-- computed at the last observation before the event.
select
    coalesce(c.company_key, cur.company_key) as company_key,
    l.company_id,
    l.event_date,
    l.n_observations,
    l.lead_months_ccc,
    l.lead_months_z,
    l.ever_red_ccc,
    l.ever_red_z,
    l.ccc_available_last,
    l.z_available_last,
    l.run_id
from "bilanzwerk"."staging"."stg_analysis__lead_times" as l
left join "bilanzwerk"."marts"."dim_company" as c
    on
        l.company_id = c.company_id
        and l.event_date >= c.valid_from
        and l.event_date < c.valid_to
-- an event before the first known company version falls back to the current one
left join "bilanzwerk"."marts"."dim_company" as cur
    on
        l.company_id = cur.company_id
        and cur.is_current = 1

-- Pooled out-of-time backtest per model (rolling yearly splits), with the champion marked.
select
    model_name,
    case when model_name = 'M3_lightgbm_all' then 1 else 0 end as is_champion,
    n as n_observations,
    n_pos as n_events,
    pr_auc,
    recall_top5,
    brier,
    run_id,
    data_version
from "bilanzwerk"."staging"."stg_analysis__model_backtest"

-- Probability of bankruptcy within 12 months per company, as-of date and model, written back
-- by the early-warning model (analysis/), with the three strongest drivers.
select
    sha256(concat_ws('||', upper(coalesce(trim(cast(g.golden_company_id as TEXT)), '')), upper(coalesce(trim(cast(r.as_of_date as TEXT)), '')), upper(coalesce(trim(cast(r.model_name as TEXT)), '')))) as risk_score_key,
    c.company_key,
    g.golden_company_id as company_id,
    r.as_of_date,
    r.model_name,
    case when r.model_name = 'M3_lightgbm_all' then 1 else 0 end as is_champion,
    r.probability_12m,
    r.risk_band,
    r.top_3_drivers,
    r.run_id
from "bilanzwerk"."staging"."stg_analysis__risk_scores" as r
inner join "bilanzwerk"."business_vault"."bv_company_golden" as g
    on
        g.company_bk_type = 'CIK'
        and r.cik = g.cik
left join "bilanzwerk"."marts"."dim_company" as c
    on
        g.golden_company_id = c.company_id
        and r.as_of_date >= c.valid_from
        and r.as_of_date < c.valid_to

select *
from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."fact_case_study"
where case_rank is null

select *
from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."fact_case_study"
where company_key is null

with child as (
    select company_key as from_field
    from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."fact_case_study"
    where company_key is not null
),

parent as (
    select company_key as to_field
    from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."dim_company"
)

select
    from_field

from child
left join parent
    on child.from_field = parent.to_field

where parent.to_field is null

select
    case_rank as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."fact_case_study"
where case_rank is not null
group by case_rank
having count(*) > 1

with all_values as (

    select
        hypothesis_code as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."fact_hypothesis_result"
    group by hypothesis_code

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'H1','H2','H3','H4'
)

with all_values as (

    select
        status as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."fact_hypothesis_result"
    group by status

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'held','not_held','not_determinable'
)

select *
from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."fact_hypothesis_result"
where hypothesis_code is null

select
    hypothesis_code as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."fact_hypothesis_result"
where hypothesis_code is not null
group by hypothesis_code
having count(*) > 1

select *
from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."fact_lead_time"
where company_id is null

with child as (
    select company_key as from_field
    from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."fact_lead_time"
    where company_key is not null
),

parent as (
    select company_key as to_field
    from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."dim_company"
)

select
    from_field

from child
left join parent
    on child.from_field = parent.to_field

where parent.to_field is null

select
    company_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."fact_lead_time"
where company_id is not null
group by company_id
having count(*) > 1

select *
from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."fact_model_backtest"
where model_name is null

select
    model_name as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."fact_model_backtest"
where model_name is not null
group by model_name
having count(*) > 1

select pr_auc
from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."fact_model_backtest"
where pr_auc is not null
    and (
        1 = 0 or pr_auc < 0 or pr_auc > 1
    )

with all_values as (

    select
        is_champion as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."fact_risk_score"
    group by is_champion

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    0,1
)

with all_values as (

    select
        risk_band as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."fact_risk_score"
    group by risk_band

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'green','yellow','red'
)

select company_id, as_of_date, model_name, count(*) as n
from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."fact_risk_score"
group by company_id, as_of_date, model_name
having count(*) > 1

select probability_12m
from "bilanzwerk"."marts"."fact_risk_score"
where probability_12m is not null
    and (
        1 = 0 or probability_12m < 0 or probability_12m > 1
    )
